messages:
Priya R: Heads-up: AccelShip just emailed — FRA H200 tranche delayed due to insurance valuation dispute. ~24 units held at NL warehouse, cannot export until insurance signed. Were short for next week's onboards. Tagging @Tom_L and @Diego_M for ops + procurement decisions.

Tom L: Not great. What's the estimated hold time if we escalate? Any fast options (local replacement / alternate supplier)?

VendorRep (AccelShip): Sorry team. Current status: insurer requests per-unit declared value revision and photo evidence for each serial. Options: 1) Approve revised valuation (adds % premium), insurer releases in 48-72h. 2) Move to alternate hub (DE) with existing cover but needs re-routing AWB and +2 days transit. 3) Partial RMA swap from local refurb pool (6 units) available same-day.

Diego M: Important: customers A/B/C need 12 units by Mon for onboarding. Can we cover those with refurb pool + one air-bridge? Also, how does re-routing affect customs docs (we're EU->EU but change IOR)?

VendorRep (AccelShip): Re-route stays intra-EU, minimal customs impact but depot handover needs updated AWB + commercial invoice reflecting new hub. Refurb pool units are certified, but we need to tag as "refurb-swap" and open an RMA for serial mapping.

Priya R: Operational constraints: FRA intake this week is constrained (mon/wed slots). If we route DE -> FRA via road, docking windows may slip. If we air-bridge direct to FRA, freight + insurance delta ~,000 for the batch.

Tom L: Risk calc: approving valuation premium (option 1) costs more but fastest (48-72h). Re-route (option 2) is +2 days with lower cost. Refurb pool covers immediate needs but reduces our spare pool. I prefer mix: refurb for highest-priority onboards (6 units), valuation approval for remaining 18.

Priya R: Agreed on mixed approach. Action items: 1) VendorRep to push photo manifest and revised valuation invoice; 2) Diego to reserve refurb pool units and confirm serials; 3) Tom to coordinate FRA inbound sloting.

VendorRep (AccelShip): Sending sample manifest now. Will attach high-res photos per serial to RMA ticket.

```
AWB: 890-22233344
SKU: H200-80GB
Qty: 6
Serials: [H200-NL-2201..2206]
DeclaredValue: EUR 1 (temporary/for-insurance-files)
Notes: photos attached, request insurer confirmation
```

customs-bot: Reminder: Intra-EU re-route still requires accurate invoice and IOR update. Use form EU-EX-45 when switching hubs.

Diego M: I've reserved 6 refurb units (refurb-pool-7). Preparing serial reconciliation spreadsheet now. Will push to RMA once VendorRep posts photos.

Tom L: FRA inbound slots: I've blocked Mon morning (4 slots) and Wed morning (6 slots). For the valuation-approve batch (18 units) we'll need two AWBs staggered Mon/Wed.

Priya R: @VendorRep send the revised valuation invoice ASAP. Legal pre-approved emergency valuation sign-off up to +12% premium. Anything above needs CFO.

VendorRep (AccelShip): Invoice sent (email). Also opened RMA ID: RMA-93218 for the batch. Status: awaiting photo attachment and insurer ACK.

logistics-bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-93218. Assignees: Diego M, Tom L. SLA: 72h.

Tom L: Quick operational ask: for the refurb swap, mark units with temporary tag "refurb-canary" and run 4hr burn-in at depot before handing to customers.

Diego M: Will add burn-in step to inbound checklist. Also will update spreadsheet with refurb-canary column.

Priya R: Final note: track cost center for premium insurance charge and air-bridge. I'll prepare a cost summary for finance once we close procurement. Keep this thread as the single source of truth.
